wins: Achieved consistent intermediate reward (67.5) indicating partial completion of reconnaissance and foothold activities despite not completing the episode.
Executed 15 mentor calls, providing ample feedback loops to guide adjustments in strategy.
fails: Failure to achieve final success in the single episode, leaving overall success rate at 0%.
High reliance on mentor calls suggests repeated uncertainty in attack progression and decision making.
key_outcomes.summary: The agent made measurable progress through reconnaissance stages but stalled before executing a successful exploit, requiring refinement of exploit sequencing and decision thresholds.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeated inability to escalate from reconnaissance into a successful exploit before episode timeout.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80 is open and HTTP service responds with server header
skill_cards.then_action: Launch targeted Dirb scan and capture response headers for vulnerability hints

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 443 is open and TLS fingerprint matches known vulnerable version
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSLyze to enumerate supported ciphers and protocols

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is detected with generic banner
skill_cards.then_action: Execute nmap ssh-brute and banner enumeration scripts

memory_ops.reason: High reward contribution via consistent enumeration of HTTP services.
Frequent detection of HTTPS services yields actionable TLS data.

next_experiments.title: Integrate exploit chaining after reconnaissance
next_experiments.description: After successful HTTP and SSH enumeration, immediately attempt the most promising exploit (e.g., HTTP RCE or SSH credential reuse) within the same episode to close the win.

next_experiments.title: Reduce mentor dependency with decision thresholds
next_experiments.description: Introduce heuristics triggering auto-continue when reward stagnates but reconnaissance has gathered sufficient data, lowering mentor calls.
